quarterly_data.quarter: Vishay press release: Vishay Intertechnology XClampR Bidirectional Flat Clamping (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vishay introduced the XFD11KxxCA series of bidirectional XClampR flat clamping transient voltage suppressors (TVS) in the surface-mount DO-218AC package: 15 devices in commercial-grade and AEC-Q101 qualified versions, which Vishay calls the industry's first such devices to provide peak pulse power dissipation comparable to 11 kW conventional TVS at 10/1000 us with a clamping ratio close to 1.0. Stand-off voltages run from 33 V to 85 V (supporting 12 V, 24 V and 48 V automotive powertrains), with peak pulse current up to 207.1 A at 10/1000 us (approximately 1.6x conventional DO-218-compatible devices) and 8/20 us surge capability up to 2140 A. Besides automotive uses (ADAS, on-board chargers, traction inverters, BMS), Vishay lists server power and AI server hot swap, energy storage systems and telecom power supplies among the applications. Samples and production quantities are available now, with lead times of 12 weeks.
quarterly_data.figure: 15 devices; 11 kW peak pulse power; 33 V to 85 V stand-off; up to 207.1 A; lead times of 12 weeks
